title: Return no content
summary: Phoenix: Return no content. Inspect the reply in an HTTP client.
introduction: send_resp can send an empty body with status 204. Send DELETE /books/1.
learningObjectives: Inspect the reply in an HTTP client

blocks.text: Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.

blocks.title: Return no content
blocks.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
delete "/books/:id", LessonController, :remove
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def remove(conn, _params), do: send_resp(conn, 204, "")
end

blocks.text: The action sends status 204 with an empty string body.
Inspect the reply in an HTTP client.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: This practice action has no database record to remove.
